import json, subprocess, sys
def run(scn):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/workspace/submission/bridge.py'], input=json.dumps(scn).encode(),
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if p.returncode: raise SystemExit(p.stderr.decode())
    return json.loads(p.stdout)
R = {"https://demo.test":"a"}
def ev(sid,t,**kw):
    d={'sid':sid,'type':t}; d.update(kw); return d
def hdr(path, method='GET', auth='demo.test', extra=()):
    return [list(p) for p in [(':method',method),(':scheme','https'),(':authority',auth),(':path',path)]+list(extra)]
def show(name, scn):
    r = run(scn)
    print("=== "+name)
    for s in r['streams']:
        print("  ", json.dumps(s))
    for l, raw in r['origins'].items():
        if raw: print("  ", l, repr(bytes.fromhex(raw).decode('latin-1')))

show("split data one chunk", {'routes':R,'events':[
  ev(0,'headers',fields=hdr('/x','POST')), ev(0,'data',hex='6162'), ev(0,'data',hex='6364'), ev(0,'fin')]})
show("cl with trailers", {'routes':R,'events':[
  ev(0,'headers',fields=hdr('/x','POST',extra=[('content-length','2')])), ev(0,'data',hex='6162'),
  ev(0,'headers',fields=[['x-audit-a','1']]), ev(0,'fin')]})
show("cl with trailers mismatch", {'routes':R,'events':[
  ev(0,'headers',fields=hdr('/x','POST',extra=[('content-length','3')])), ev(0,'data',hex='6162'),

show("body looks like request", {'routes':R,'events':[
  ev(0,'headers',fields=hdr('/x','POST')), ev(0,'data',hex='484554502f312e31' + '0d0a'), ev(0,'fin')]})
show("body with nul", {'routes':R,'events':[
  ev(0,'headers',fields=hdr('/x','POST')), ev(0,'data',hex='000102ff'), ev(0,'fin')]})
show("x-list multiple suffixes", {'routes':R,'events':[
  ev(0,'headers',fields=hdr('/x',extra=[('x-list-a','1'),('x-list-b','2'),('x-list-a','3'),('x-list-b','4')])), ev(0,'fin')]})
show("empty initial section", {'routes':R,'events':[
  ev(0,'headers',fields=[]), ev(0,'fin')]})
show("options star http route", {'routes':{"http://demo.test":"a"},'events':[
  ev(0,'headers',fields=[[':method','OPTIONS'],[':scheme','http'],[':authority','demo.test'],[':path','*']]), ev(0,'fin')]})
show("cookie with empty value", {'routes':R,'events':[
  ev(0,'headers',fields=hdr('/x',extra=[('cookie',''),('cookie','b=2')])), ev(0,'fin')]})
show("value with tab interior", {'routes':R,'events':[
  ev(0,'headers',fields=hdr('/x',extra=[('x-note','a\tb')])), ev(0,'fin')]})
show("value 0x80 edge", {'routes':R,'events':[
  ev(0,'headers',fields=hdr('/x',extra=[('x-note','\u0080')])), ev(0,'fin')]})
show("value DEL", {'routes':R,'events':[
  ev(0,'headers',fields=hdr('/x',extra=[('x-note','\u007f')])), ev(0,'fin')]})
show("path with query preserved", {'routes':R,'events':[
